actions.action: Check whether sun damage is only on sun-facing leaves
Push a finger 2 cm into the soil to check moisture
Check that the pot drains and roots aren't soft or smelly
Move plant out of direct sun to bright indirect light or shade
Water thoroughly until it drains, then empty the saucer
Water when top layer feels dry to keep soil lightly moist
Mist the plant to raise humidity
Alternatively set the pot on a pebble tray with water
Trim crispy dead leaves and black or mushy stems
Check again in a few days whether stems are firm and green

reason: The main diagnosis is dehydration/heat stress and the key advice is a thorough watering after a soil check, which matches the confirmed fix; nothing in it is harmful.
